response.rationale: R4 captures both the radiological pattern (ground glass opacities, crazy paving, bilateral lower lobe involvement) and the positive PCR, directly supporting COVID-19 pneumonia. R1 only cites PCR, missing the imaging evidence that specifies pneumonia. Others (R2, R3, R5, R6) rely on non-diagnostic contextual factors (vaccine, rituximab) without direct evidence of the diagnosis.

rejected.why: Lacks imaging evidence; breakthrough infection is subsumed by pneumonia diagnosis but less specific.
Only cites vaccine history; no raw support for immune reconstitution or temporal association.
